claims.text: Keratitis: topical trifluridine, typically w an ophthalmologist
claims.quote: For keratitis, topical trifluridine (typically in consultation with an ophthalmologist)

claims.text: Acyclovir-resistant HSV: rare, almost only in immunocompromised pts; also resistant to penciclovir, famciclovir and valacyclovir
claims.quote: Infection with acyclovir-resistant HSV is rare and occurs almost exclusively in patients who are immunocompromised. Acyclovir-resistant strains are resistant to penciclovir, famciclovir, and valacyclovir.

claims.text: Foscarnet may be effective for acyclovir-resistant infections
claims.quote: Foscarnet may be effective for acyclovir-resistant infections.
